purpose: Controlled snapshot attention comparison followed by trajectory-history ablation
augmentation: One common lateral reflection sign per sample and all its history frames
inference: Equal-weight three-seed ensemble, mirror averaging for each seed
snapshot_control: Same current features, target, match splits, group-mean pooling and bounded output as frozen GNN; parameter counts within 2%
history_control: Same transformer weights and parameter count across conditions; history versus repeated current values at the same observed-history masks for current players
time_encoder: Player-aligned trajectory attention before current spatial blocks; shares projections with first spatial block
target: Signed first future shot transferred geometry-xG in (t,t+15s], including interruptions
selection: Choose gnn, snapshot or history by validation ensemble MSE; repeat is diagnostic only
uncertainty: Exact whole-match descriptive bootstrap, 27 ordered resamples of three test matches
scope: Previously consumed test matches; exploratory comparison, not a fresh confirmatory test or a causal tactical claim
